note: Fin rotation: every fin set can now rotate about the body axis (real physics, 3D + aft view, .ork and RockSim round-trip), and RockSim imports automatically interleave fin sets that arrive on top of each other (the 4in Ultra Neon case). Plus 6-motor clusters can batch as three opposite pairs - mixed 4+2 and 2+2+2 motor configurations, the affordable way to fly a 6-ring.
